title: Reading Between the Lines
text:
Many students believe that a text is only useful when every sentence is clear. In reality, good readers often tolerate uncertainty and look for the main idea first. When a writer uses a word that seems unfamiliar, the context usually gives enough clues to guess its meaning. Careful readers therefore avoid stopping at every difficult word.

However, guessing from context is not always reliable. Sometimes the surrounding sentences are vague, and a wrong guess can change the whole meaning of a paragraph. In such cases, readers should check the word in a dictionary or reread the passage slowly. Balancing these two strategies is the key to strong reading comprehension.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what do good readers usually look for first?
options: the exact meaning of every word
the main idea of the text
the longest sentence in the passage

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what can happen when a guess from context is wrong?
options: the reader finishes the text faster
the meaning of a whole paragraph can change

questions.text: What can be inferred about the writer's attitude toward strategies for reading?
options: Guessing from context should always be avoided
Good reading depends on combining more than one strategy
Dictionaries are the only useful reading tool
Students should read only short texts

questions.text: Why does the writer suggest that readers should not stop at every difficult word?
options: Constant stopping can interrupt the flow and the overall understanding
Teachers prefer students to ignore vocabulary
Dictionaries are too slow to use

vocabulary.definition: the words and situation surrounding a word that help explain its meaning
a state of not being sure about something
not clear or precise in meaning

paragraph_translations: Pek çok öğrenci, bir metnin yalnızca her cümlesi açık olduğunda faydalı olduğuna inanır. Oysa iyi okuyucular genellikle belirsizliğe tolerans gösterir ve önce ana fikri aramaya çalışır. Yazar tanıdık olmayan bir kelime kullandığında, bağlam genellikle anlamını tahmin etmek için yeterli ipucunu verir. Dikkatli okuyucular bu yüzden her zor kelimede durmaktan kaçınır.

Ancak bağlamdan tahmin yürütmek her zaman güvenilir değildir. Bazen çevredeki cümleler belirsizdir ve yanlış bir tahmin bütün bir paragrafın anlamını değiştirebilir. Bu durumlarda okuyucular kelimeyi sözlükte kontrol etmeli ya da metni yavaşça yeniden okumalıdır. Güçlü bir okuma becerisinin anahtarı, bu iki stratejiyi dengelemektir.
